statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-6276: when an application sets a custom Host: header for one request and then makes another request with the same libcurl easy handle without it, the second request uses the stale host name for cookie matching and can send cookies meant for the first host (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-6276.html). It affects libcurl 7.71.0 to 8.19.0 and was fixed in curl 8.20.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/3a19987a87f393d9394fe5acc7643f6c263c92db, which moves the stored cookie host from the handle-wide state into the per-request state (struct SingleRequest) so it is cleared for each request. As of 2026-11-27 the DHI Alpine 3.23 main repository publishes curl builds 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. In the debug information shipped in curl-dbg, on x86_64 and aarch64, the cookie host is a member of the handle-wide allocated state in 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 and 8.19.0-r0, and a member of struct SingleRequest in every build from 8.20.0-r0 on. So 8.20.0-r0, the first build of curl 8.20.0, is the first fixed build.

CVE-2026-6276: when an application sets a custom Host: header for one request and then makes another request with the same libcurl easy handle without it, the second request uses the stale host name for cookie matching and can send cookies meant for the first host (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-6276.html). It affects libcurl 7.71.0 to 8.19.0 and was fixed in curl 8.20.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/3a19987a87f393d9394fe5acc7643f6c263c92db, which moves the stored cookie host from the handle-wide state into the per-request state (struct SingleRequest) so it is cleared for each request. Debian backported the fix to trixie in 8.14.1-2+deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-6276). The DHI curl packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie curl 8.14.1-2; as of 2026-11-27 the DHI Debian repository publishes three of them (the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 and two rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7) for amd64 and arm64, all later than 8.14.1-2+deb13u4, and each ships a Debian changelog that records the fix under 8.14.1-2+deb13u4. In the debug information of libcurl4t64 and libcurl3t64-gnutls of all three builds, on amd64 and arm64, the cookie host is a member of struct SingleRequest and not of the handle-wide state, as in the fixed code, which Debian's own unfixed 8.14.1-2+deb13u3 libcurl4t64 build (amd64) does not have. Every published build carries the fix, so the fixed version is the lowest published one, the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5.
